senses.gloss:
1. जुष् जुष्, i. 6, Ātm. (also Par., Hariv. 7430).
 1. To be pleased, Mārk. P. 31, 49.
 2. To enjoy, MBh. 2, 1718.
 3. To like, MBh. 3, 12732.
 4. To undergo, Bhāg. P. 8, 7, 20.
 5. To frequent, MBh. 3, 2464.
 6. To befall, MBh. 3, 11061. जुष्ट,
 1. Loved, Chr. 293, 1 = Rigv. i. 87, 1.
 2. Endowed, Bhāg. P. 1, 19, 20.
 --Caus. जोषय, To agree, MBh. 14, 1289.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To frequent, MBh. 5, 1040.
 --With अव अव, To visit, MBh. 13, 645.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To resolve upon, Hariv. 7431 (precat. Par., or ii. 2, potent.).
 --With निस् निस्, निर्जुष्ट, Frequented, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 21.
 --With प्र प्र, प्र-जष्ट, Strongly attached to, Man. 2, 96.
 --With सम् सम्, संजुष्ट, Frequented, [] MBh. 13, 646.
 --Cf. Lat. gustus, gustare; γεύω; Goth. kiusan; A.S. ceosan, also cyssan; Goth. kukjan, cf. with ved. जुज्; cf. कुस्.

2. जुष् जुष्, adj.
 1. Loving, attached to, Bhāg. P. 7, 6, 25; especially as latter part of comp. words, e. g. Bhāg. P. 4, 9, 36.
 2. Visiting, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 25.

3. जुष् जुष्, i. 1 and 10, Par.
 1. † To reason or to hurt.
 2. To satisfy.
 --Cf. 1. जुष्.
† जूष् जूष्, i. 1, Par. To hurt.
